purpose: Everything outside git that the prior pre-training experiment depends on: code at recorded commits, package versions, the GPU, and the sha256 of every downloaded or generated file. Files themselves live under .cache/tfmp/.

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060, 6 GB, driver 591.86 (CUDA 13.1), WDDM

ticl.why: imported at the top of tfmplayground.external_priors

tabpfn-v1-prior.why: imported at the top of tfmplayground.external_priors

.cache/tfmp/released/nanotabpfn_regresso.use: smoke test of the quantile adapter only; trained on 50-row tables, not an arm
.cache/tfmp/released/nanotabpfn_regresso.layout: bare state dict from before TFM-Playground e88b8d9: embedding 128, hidden 512, 6 layers, 100 outputs; 2 heads by that era's rule embedding // 64

pilot.dump: 64 tables, experiments/h3_repair/prior_pretraining_dump.py defaults, 12 s on CPU; largest z 4.00 and largest sd shift of a whole table 1.0074. Too few tables: the full shards reach z 22.6, see dumps

throughput.batch 1, no sdpa, no checkpointing: peak 7863 MB on a 6 GB card, 0.11 to 0.15 tables/s

pilot.equivalence: on CPU float32, checkpointing changes outputs and gradients by 0; need_weights=False by at most 4.2e-07 in outputs and 3.7e-09 in gradients

budget.decided: 2026-09-15, after the pilot: about 3 GPU hours per run, 1000 buckets, 2 pre-training seeds
budget.target_clip_why: decided 2026-09-15 after the first A0B1 run: on shard 2026 the robust scale is below 0.01 sd in 2.68% of contexts, encoded targets reach 2.2e9, fp16 gives NaN. Share of contexts the cap touches (first 5000 tables): A0B0 0%, A0B1 0.70%, A1B0 0%, A1B1 2.60%; a cap at 100 would have touched 47.7% of A1B1 contexts and acted as a context repair
budget.why_steps_not_hours: every arm gets the same optimiser steps and the same tables in the same order; wall time is recorded per run

dumps.generation: four processes in parallel, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, prior_pretraining_dump.py defaults (mix_scm, 1024 rows, 2 to 32 features, context 512 to 896, gen_batch 16, batch_size_per_gp 4), seeds 2026 to 2029; training reads them in this order
dumps.checks: every shard: all y finite, no constant table, 1024 rows, padding columns zero; the first tables of the four shards differ
dumps.arm_A0_as_generated: seed 2026, all 14000 tables: max z beyond 4.05 in 3.16% (5: 1.44%, 10: 0.31%, largest 22.6), as often on the lower side (431 tables); sd shift of the whole table median 1.0052, 99.9% 1.132, largest 1.413; sd shift of the context 4 or more in 2 tables, 20 or more in none, largest 10.1

nanoTabPFN-A0B0-s1.target_clip: none: trained before the cap. Of its 56000 tables, 3 exceed 100 encoded units and 1 exceeds 10000 (48170.8), so the cap would have changed one table. Kept by decision of 2026-09-15; the adapter reads it with the cap

failed.nanoTabPFN-A0B1-s1 without target_clip: 2026-09-15 14:45 to 14:52, stopped at step 150 of 7000: edges [-6.25e6, 2.21e9], loss NaN at steps 50 and 150. Log in .cache/tfmp/failed/
